text: No, I believe Leonard is waiting for you to come crawling back to him and apologize. I assumed that would be your attitude. Hence, my true purpose in coming here. I want you to crawl back to him and apologize.

text: I have a few questions. First, I notice that you offer soup and a half-sandwich? Where exactly does the half-sandwich come from? Are you giving me half of someone else's sandwich, or do I have to wait for someone else in the restaurant to order the other half?
